agent_0.policy: As Agent 0, your primary role is to gather ingredients and prepare pots for cooking. Always prioritize picking up and placing onions in pots. Communicate with Agent 1 when your pots are full to avoid blockage.

agent_1.policy: As Agent 1, your main duty is to cook and deliver soups. Once you see that Agent 0 has placed ingredients in the pot, focus on monitoring the cooking process and start plating and delivering soups quickly. Avoid picking up ingredients unless Agent 0 requests assistance.

agent_0.policy: As Agent 0, your role is to gather ingredients and assist in cooking. Focus on picking up ingredients, but also be ready to monitor cooking pots and assist with plating when needed. Communicate with Agent 1 if you notice they are blocked or if pots are not being monitored.
